data.title: 五河琴里 · 贵妃软榻上的任性私心
data.action: 侧躺在沙发贵妃榻上，单手拿着珍宝珠棒棒糖含在唇间，白缎带双马尾散落，白皙小巧的脚尖在空中轻晃，眼神软糯又带着小小的霸道。
data.location: 温馨客厅的长绒贵妃沙发上，散落着草莓靠垫与卡通毯子
data.lighting: 暖金色的斜阳斜斜切入客厅，在地板上拉长柔和的树影与光斑
data.mood: 妹妹模式的娇憨可爱与任性依赖，午后甜美慵懒
data.description: 温馨客厅的长绒贵妃沙发上，散落着草莓靠垫与卡通毯子。侧躺在沙发贵妃榻上，单手拿着珍宝珠棒棒糖含在唇间，白缎带双马尾散落，白皙小巧的脚尖在空中轻晃，眼神软糯又带着小小的霸道。 她微微抬眸轻语——“司令官模式下班了啦……笨蛋哥哥，现在就只是琴里一个人，还不快点过来坐？”
data.promptProse: Viewed from the side across a sunlit living-room sofa strewn with cushions and cozy throws, Kotori lounges lazily with a lollipop between her lips and her white hair ribbons splayed out, looking over with a spoiled, affectionate pout.
data.animaCaption: Stretched sideways across the plush living-room chaise sofa hugging a strawberry cushion with a lollipop tucked in her mouth, she kicks her bare feet playfully and gives a spoiled glance in her crimson strawberry-print linen babydoll with white satin ribbons.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a short crimson strawberry-print linen babydoll nightdress laced with criss-cross white satin ribbons at the bust and a ruffled hem revealing her bare legs and bare feet.
